dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi! I’m looking for a high-quality pair of shoes. My budget is between $500 and $5,000. Could you recommend something in that range with decent reviews?
dialogue.agent: Currently, there are no shoes in inventory priced between $500 and $2,000 with average customer ratings of 3.5 or higher. Would you consider expanding your budget range or adjusting your preferences? I can also look for shoes closer to $500 with good reviews if you're interested.

dialogue.user: Thanks for letting me know! Since my budget actually goes up to $5,000, could you tell me if you have any shoes priced between $2,000 and $5,000, as long as the average rating is at least 2/5.0? Also, how many customer reviews do those options typically have?
dialogue.agent: There is one option available in your updated price range: "adidas Men's SS 2G Slide PLUS Slide" priced at $2,000. It has an average rating of 2.8 out of 5.0, based on 6 customer reviews. Would you like more details or reviews for this shoe, or would you like to refine your search criteria?

products.title: adidas Men's SS 2G Slide PLUS Slide
products.description: Superstar 2G inspired, this slide has a sporty style. Its comfortable FitFOAM footbed molds to the foot, while the 3-Stripes upper has a pull tab for adjustments. adidas is a name that stands for excellence in all sectors of sport around the globe. The vision of company founder Adolf Dassler has become a reality, and his corporate philosophy has been the guiding principle for successor generations. The idea was as simple as it was brilliant: to provide every athlete with the best possible equipment. It all began in 1920, when Adi Dassler made his first shoes using the few materials available after the First World War. Today, the adidas product range extends from shoes, apparel, and accessories for basketball, soccer, fitness and training to adventure, trail and golf.

dialogue.user: Thanks for the info. Could you please share some of the customer review text for "adidas Men's SS 2G Slide PLUS Slide"? I’d like to see what people are saying about it before deciding.
dialogue.agent:
Here are some top customer reviews for "adidas Men's SS 2G Slide PLUS Slide":

1. "My husband absolutely loves these shoes!! They are very comfortable and made extremely well—especially as he can be hard on shoes.... Overall a really great purchase."
2. "This is my third pair of these wonderful slides. These are by far the most comfortable I have ever worn... the foam gives but is also very supportive."
3. "I just received these today... I'm pleased so far. The foam is going to take a couple of days to soften up & I'm sure I'll luv them afterwards."

Would you like more product details or wish to consider other options?

top_reviews.title: Great shoes
top_reviews.text: My husband absolutely loves these shoes!! They are very comfortable and made extremely well- especially as he can be hard on shoes. My one very important note is to buy a size larger than normal. But overall a really great purchase.

top_reviews.title: very nice
top_reviews.text: this is my third pair of these wonderful slides.I have had numerous types of sandals,flip flops,beachwear etc.these are by far the most comfortable I have ever worn.The way they surround your feet is incredible the foam gives but is also very supportive.I have suggested these to many folks and everyone has nothing but good things to say.

top_reviews.title: So far so good!
top_reviews.text: I just received these today 2 days ahead of schedule & I'm pleased so far. & thankfully I read someone elses review & ordered the next size up. Being new the foam is going to take a couple of days to soften up & I'm sure I'll luv them afterwards.

dialogue.user: Those reviews sound pretty positive, especially about comfort and durability, which I appreciate. Given that "adidas Men's SS 2G Slide PLUS Slide" is at the lower end of my price range with an average rating above 2 and solid feedback for comfort, I think it matches my preferences well enough. I’m ready to purchase for these reasons: the price is within my budget, the average rating meets my minimum, and the review comments highlight features I care about. <YES>
